high_level_description: The image shows a computer monitor displaying a desktop screen with an open application window for AnyDesk. The main content of the screen is a message box that reads "Client Offline" with the text: "This desk is not available. Please make sure that AnyDesk is running on the remote device and it is connected to the internet." Below this message, there are three buttons labeled "Power on," "Retry," and "Cancel." The monitor is a Dell brand, as indicated by the logo at the bottom of the frame.
